description: The plugin refuses a path holding ", ', `, $, \, ;, |, &, <, > or a line break, besides : and , which the line refuses already; a control character cannot be shown as it is either, nor a format character, such as U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE (G16). With --omv such a branch is refused, with exit 1 and nothing on standard output; without it the line has it, as mergerfs takes it.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "/srv/mergerfs/pool"
[placement]
min_free = ["1GiB"]
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "x1"
uuid = "6e5d4c3b-2a19-4f8e-8d7c-6b5a4f3e2d1c"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/x1"
fs = "xfs"
root = "Films&Series"
